name: A sus chord in its most basic form is a dominant chord that isn't fully resolved.
use_when: Ngẫu hứng jazz trên hợp âm F7sus
Chọn gam / scale khi gặp hợp âm 7sus4 trong nhạc jazz
avoid_when: Đệm hát ballad Việt — đây là gam jazz, không phải bài của thầy Hải Joseph

output.source_text: A sus chord in its most basic form is a dominant chord that isn't fully resolved. Instead of 1-3-5-7, it uses 1-4-5-7, where the 4th acts as a suspension that doesn't resolve directly to the 3rd.

note_vi: Bài 25 của nguồn Jazz Scales (YouTube), mốc 00:15-00:54. A sus chord in its most basic form is a dominant chord that isn't fully resolved. Instead of 1-3-5-7, it uses 1-4-5-7, where the 4th acts as a suspension that doesn't resolve directly to the 3rd. Nguồn giảng bằng tiếng Anh, câu trên giữ nguyên lời giảng.
